message.content:
In French, “hello” is most commonly translated as **“bonjour.”**  
It’s a polite greeting you use during daylight hours (morning through late afternoon). If it’s later at night, people usually say **“bonsoir,”** which literally means “good evening.”

So:

| English | French |
|---------|--------|
| Hello   | bonjour |

Feel free to ask if you'd like more details on other informal ways to greet someone!
